answer: Problem: Sybil clusters share one operator and flood panels. Mechanism: require each identity to plant a lotus of time-locked attest work—12 distinct willow peer edges over 72h, each edge hashed into a relic bond of 0.012 POA that only matures when the peer grade median stays at least 2. Cost: 0.144 POA locked plus 12 attest slots. Verification: any over 40 percent edge overlap with a rejected cluster voids all immature bonds. Failure: broken maturity window or median below 2 burns 50 percent and bars panel seats for one epoch.
